headlines.text: It was 2020 when the AEW World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as FTR vs. Best Friends went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.49. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
That Friday in 2022, The Embassy announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.02.

Rewind to 2020, when Cody vs. Orange Cassidy fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.63. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2022, it was Castagnoli & Moxley's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.60.
2020 brought us this moment: the AEW World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Jon Moxley vs. Lance Archer went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.59.
That Wednesday in 2020, Hikaru Shida vs. Big Swole went to battle over the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 3.75. For Big Swole, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
